procedure_name: Street Vendor Vending Certificate & ID Card
summary: Registration under Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood and Regulation of Street Vending) Act for hawkers and cart operators.

steps.title: Participation in Town Vending Survey
steps.description: Verify inclusion in municipal biometric street vendor survey list or apply during quarterly open enrollment.

steps.title: Application for vending zone
steps.description: Submit preference for designated vending zones (stationary, mobile, or weekly market).

steps.title: Verification by Town Vending Committee (TVC)
steps.description: TVC reviews applicant credentials and conducts non-overlap verification.

steps.title: Allotment of designated vending spot
steps.description: Receive allotment letter with mapped geo-coordinates within designated vending zone.

steps.title: Issuance of Smart Vending Card
steps.description: Collect smart card containing QR code, photo, and permitted trade hours.
